title: Culturally-Grounded Chain-of-Thought (CG-CoT): Enhancing LLM Performance on Culturally-Specific Tasks in Low-Resource Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the cultural depth and accuracy of LLM interpretations of culturally-specific Yoruba proverbs using automated metrics (BLEU, BERTScore) and LLM-as-a-judge, which exposes anglocentric blind spots and a bias toward surface-level fluency over true cultural fidelity.

Assessing model performance on translating and reasoning about idiomatic and metaphorical expressions in a low-resource language (Yoruba) to highlight disparities caused by the English-centric nature of most pretraining corpora.
